title: ID0424503-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S8 170003981] No receipt will be issued.
description:

I can only try to find the reason for this.
The excerpt from the loading log is not sufficient, but I will create a log record via the Terminal Management System and check this as soon as the log is available."

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0424503-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S8 170003981] No receipt will be issued. CRM:02678000063
additional_info.body:
Hallo Francisco,
Ich kenne die Ticketnummer nicht mehr aber es ist ein altes Problem das keine Belege erstellt werden können.
Ich werde immer wieder von Kunden angesprochen die unbedingt einen Beleg benötigen.
Sehr geehrter Herr Frenger,
ich habe am Mittwoch (14.05.2025) um ca.
19:10
Ihren Hof aufgesucht, um mein Elektroauto zu Laden.
Dabei sind einige Kritikpunkte aufgefallen, die leider dafür sorgen, dass man die Ladesäule am Heinrichshof nicht erneut aufsuchen wird:
Eine Ladesäule funktioniert nicht -> Lademöglichkeiten sehr eingeschränkt
Es ist mein Firmenwagen und ich brauche einen Beleg für den Ladevorgang.
Leider war es nicht möglich einen Beleg zu erhalten. Fehlermeldung siehe Anhang.
Meine Kreditkarte ist heute noch mit 40 € vorgemerkt. Ist dies ein üblicher Vorgang?
Ich weiß nicht wie viel KW ich geladen habe
Ich weiß auch nicht wie viel Euro der Ladevorgang mich gekostet hat
Es hat also noch keine Abbuchung stattgefunden
Die Vormerkung müsste gelöscht werden und die korrekte Abbuchung erfolgen
Unter diesen oben beschriebenen Umständen kann ich leider meine Firmenautos nicht mehr zum Heinrichshof zum Laden senden.
Es wäre sehr wünschenswert, wenn diese Umstände behoben werden.
Herzliche Grüße

I don't remember the ticket number, but it's an old problem that no receipts can be created.
I'm constantly being contacted by customers who absolutely need a receipt.
Dear Mr. Frenger,
I visited your farm on Wednesday (May 14, 2025) at approximately 7:10 PM to charge my electric car.
I noticed a few issues that unfortunately mean I won't be using the charging station at Heinrichshof again:
One charging station isn't working -> charging options are very limited
It's my company car, and I need a receipt for the charging process.
Unfortunately, it wasn't possible to obtain a receipt. See the attachment for the error message.
My credit card is still charged €40 today. Is this a normal procedure?
I don't know how many kilowatts I've charged.
I also don't know how much the charging process cost me.
So, no charge has been made yet.
The reservation would have to be deleted and the correct charge made.
Under the circumstances described above, I can unfortunately no longer send my company cars to Heinrichshof for charging.
It would be very desirable if these circumstances could be resolved.

additional_info.subject: ID0424503-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S8 170003981] No receipt will be issued. CRM:02678000063
additional_info.body:
Hallo Michael, good morning.
We had a chat with CCV and they were not able to provide the information we were hoping for.
According to their support team:
"I have the terminal log, but unfortunately the data from May 14 has already been overwritten.
I am therefore unable to carry out an analysis."
I know you created a new ticket under the number ID0426656, which I'm supporting my colleague, and already requested CCV to provide an answer, so that we don't lose the data again.
I also requested in what period should we report the issue since the data gets overwritten after a few days (not specified).
I'm very sorry that we couldn't help you this case, in the future when you have these problems please refer my name "Francisco Joaquim", this way we can speed up the process and get a faster reply.
Since we are not able to provide anything else, can I close the ticket?
I am willing to reply to any questions you have before closing the ticket.
Again, thank you for your patience and support so far.
Best regards,
Francisco
